integrity: Full mathematical argument and self-contained exact-checker evidence accompany the result; computational checks are finite and do not certify an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite caterpillar trees and nonequivariant simple homotopy only; independent external verification and exhaustive priority review not performed. The supporting March 2026 preprint concerns general-position enumeration, not the theorem proved here.
title: Graph retracts of general-position complexes of caterpillar trees
